exposure: Gestational age at time of neurosurgical emergency
cohort: 6 pregnant women who presented with neurosurgical emergencies
finding: Treatment of neurosurgical emergencies during pregnancy needs to be customized depending on the clinical condition of the pregnant woman, prognosis of the disease, gestational age and the status of the pregnancy.
mod_finding: Three patients who were near term underwent lower cesarean section followed by emergency neurosurgical procedure in the same sitting.
gest_age: Mean gestational age not specified, 4 patients in third trimester, 2 patients in second trimester
